out to 10 NM...

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by upstream dam release continues.

* WHERE...Maricopa County in south central Arizona...
Northeastern Yuma County in southwestern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 1100 AM MST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is expected. Low-water crossings are
likely to become inundated with water and may not be passable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 100 PM MST, water releases from Painted Rock Dam continue with
flow peaking around 3000 cfs. A streamflow gauge immediately
downstream also indicated a stage near 10 feet.
- Flooding is expected along the Gila River.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Farmlands and low-water crossings along the Gila River.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.region: Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 20-60 nm
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line 20-60 nm...

* Until 500 PM EST.

* At 257 PM EST, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line from 33 NM northeast of
Daytona Beach Shores to 40 NM northeast of Apollo Beach, or along a
line from 33 NM east of Ormond-By-the-Sea to 42 NM northeast of
Edgewater, moving northwest at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Mainly open waters of Flagler Beach to Volusia-Brevard County Line
20-60 nm.

temperatures as low as 28 degrees. For Saturday night into Sunday
morning, expect sub-freezing temperatures and localized hard freeze
conditions as low as 25 degrees.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast Gila County.

* WHEN...For the first Freeze Warning, from midnight tonight to 9 AM
MST Saturday. For the second Freeze Warning, from midnight Saturday
Night to 9 AM MST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill sensitive
vegetation, possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing, and
affect those camping or staying outdoors.
